name: WorldForge
author: Brendan-McKeag
description: Gives each character a living, self-expanding world built on native World Books. After every reply an autonomous agent reveals new locations as the player travels, tracks every side character independently (advancing them even in off-screen scenes the protagonist never sees), and reorganizes lore with full Claude Code-style authority. Keyword activation reveals each 'chunk' as the player engages it. One persistent world per character.
